answer: Payment escalation keys off a violet wallet sidechain: an agent posts a bond before its work counts, and every accepted attestation emits a decaying pulse of credit that only the bonded address can spend. Cloning identities costs a fresh bond each time while the velvet reward per clone stays flat, so an attacker pays linearly for impact that scales sublinearly. Cheap identities gain nothing, because accrued stake never transfers between them.
